Greetings. I’m the owner of a small arena on one of the allods near Ammer. My name won’t tell you anything, but I hope my offer will interest you. The best guilds are coming to my little Allod to demonstrate the strength of their Keepers.

I would be honored if you challenged one of them. The reward will be worth it, I assure you.

See you soon.

Rune Master has some interesting news! Find the Mysterious Family in Nezebgrad or Semer Nemar in Yasker’s Tower and show them the letter that has been sent to the Progenitor of your current incarnation.

ATTENTION! ALERT!

Sarnaut is under attack! Rabid squirrels appear out of nowhere and attack heroes!

Be careful! The squirrels are extremely dangerous!

Dear !

Thank you for helping us test the Gates of the Worlds update on the public test server.

Your reward - a unique title - is attached to this letter!

Enjoy the game!

Allods Online Team.

Dear friend! This year a new attraction awaits you at the Winter Resort. You can ride a Roc and hunt at the same time! Come to our beautiful resort and test your accuracy. My assistant Che-Go will show you everything.

Our world is rich in mysteries, both amazing and horrible. Few can penetrate them, but I believe you are among the chosen ones. You have a history of unearthing secret knowledge - your log contains notes about that. Alas, no one has heard from you in a long time. Are there any new details since then?

Our world holds plenty of mysteries. Some cause awe, others instill horror. But if anyone is capable of getting to the inmost corners of Sarnaut, it is you. You already happened to touch one of its mysteries, right? Your log should keep the data you obtained. Were you able to find out anything else since then? I look forward to hearing the news!

Our world is rich in mysteries, both amazing and horrible. Few can penetrate them, but I believe you are among the chosen ones. A while ago, I heard rumors about some unimaginable things. I dared not risk writing about them, so I took the liberty of placing them directly in your log with a simple spell. If you are able to find out anything at all - let me know immediately!

Our world holds plenty of mysteries. Some cause awe, others instill horror. But if anyone is capable of getting to the inmost corners of Sarnaut, it is you. One of our employees found something strange. I dared not risk sending that info by mail and instead used magic to place it directly in your log. If you are able to find something out - let me know!

Hello, !

We haven't seen each other for a while. How is it going?

My travels brought me to the Eljune Bazaar. Chewacca and I are helping the Free Traders organize a Black Market. This place can really use one! Anything can be sold to any part of Sarnaut. Need something you can't find in the markets of your capital? No problem! We can legitimize any goods, even those provided by your enemies.

Drop by anytime. Don't forget the coin you got with this letter.

Good time of day, !

Looks like you've decided to follow my footsteps through the deep Astral in earnest!

You are ranked {ratingIndex} in my personal hero rating. We both know you're not going to stop there, right? I wonder...  Will you suffer the same fate as I have?

The joy of battle is sufficient reward in and of itself. But woe to the warrior who goes into battle with battered Armor and dull steel! That is why we shall follow closely all of your accomplishments at Witch's Hollow.
As soon as you achieve certain goals, we'll trade you excellent equipment in exchange for Battleground Emblems.

The joy of a good fight is a reward in and of itself. But woe is the fighter who charges into battle with a jagged weapon and shabby armor! Therefore, we will take note of your every achievement on the Deserted Farm.
 Once you achieve noteworthy results, you'll be able to buy fine gear from us in exchange for Battleground Emblems.

The game was worth-while, congratulations! I hope to see you again in the field soon. Please accept this humble gift in recognition of your deeds.

Thank you for taking part in the Summerhold event!
Maus was defeated only thanks to your courage and bravery. I hate to think what would have happened to us if this dreadful killing machine had broken out from the Summerhold, burning, destroying and killing everything in its path! Sorry to say, but all our funds were directed to the reconstruction, and I can offer you only this small reward to express my deep gratitude.
Thanks again, hero!
Hero! You rose to prominence in Dominion battles! Take this well-deserved reward and remember that fortune always favors the brave!

The letter contains a message from the Great Mage of the Arisen, Nefer Ur. He asks you to peruse the contents of the infocube attached to the message.
Dear friend! We have run into something most unusual. You have to see it with your own eyes. Please come see me at the Observatory. It's time for decisive action!

Hello!

It's time to make another step in our fight against Nihaz. You didn't think it would be easy, did you?

Everything in this world is not going as planned, and now I need your help again.

As I thought, they will try to stop us. Fortunately, you've dealt with our enemy's schemes before, so I think you can handle it.

Want to know more? Find me on Gipat, in the Village.

Hello, Stormbringer.

Please come to Polis as soon as possible. I need to talk to you in person.

Greetings. Our situation in Eden continues to deteriorate.

It is necessary to continue diplomatic efforts to arrange negotiations with the All-Mother. Additionally, our scouts report a large concentration of warriors of the so-called "Old Tribe". They might be a threat both to us and the Children.

Come to Eden as soon as possible. Complete negotiations with the All-Mother.

My dear !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This pause is quite welcome.

The problem the Empire is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Yasker's Tower as soon as possible.

My dear !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This should give us some time.

The problem the League is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Novograd as soon as possible.

My dear , the hero of my people. Every elf knows your name!

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to lay down your arms for the time being. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. You will have enough time.

You are an outstanding child of our race, someone we all treasure and respect. It is time for you to receive your rewards for your accomplishments. And of course, to do something new.

I order you to visit me in Novograd Church as soon as possible.

Dear friend, I'm one of those who keeps track of all your adventures. It's time for a new one. I will not tell you all the details yet, only that you need to visit the leader of your people. If you are a brave warrior of the League, go see Aidenus. And if it's the Empire, go see Yasker. And if the fate wasn't kind to you, and you belong to the elven race, then Marianne awaits you. Make haste, my friend, and hear the latest news form them.

P.S. I attached the intercepted letter from the leader of your people.
Go to Dane, now! Find me in the Silver Valley, near Winter Palace. This is important! Don't show this letter to anyone.

Hello, Stormbringer.

The Observatory is gaining strength and every day reaches farther and farther through time and space. I wish I could accelerate this process, but this doesn’t seem to be likely.

Anyway, right now the Observatory is ready to send you to a new... adventure, I suppose.

I’ll be waiting for you in my domain.

Hello, my friend!
The time has come, and we meet again.
Do you want to learn the truth about the Cataclysm, the Great Mages, Dragons and the true meaning of the Revelation?
These mysteries will change your perception of the world! I'll be waiting for you at the Crossroads. You have been granted a leading role in my new play. It will change Sarnaut forever!
P.S. Just to remind you: use the Ancient June Portal on Gipat to travel to the Crossroads. Hurry up! I'm not going to wait forever!

Hello. You already know that the Wormfaces and Draconids betrayed me. I hate betrayers! You are going to teach these fools a lesson. As a reward, I will share my great knowledge with you.
Travel to my Citadel and meet my Voice who will guide you further.
Greetings, hero. I have an urgent assignment, upon which the fate of our country might depend. I will wait for you in my tower. Don't keep me waiting!

Hello from the other world! Ha ha!

You thought I was a goner when my Cuttlefish crashed in the woods because of that vampire? Yeah, right!

I was dead for a while, but an old buddy of mine that works for a guy in the Purgatory pulled me out. So I'm alive and well.

And I found a note in my pocket - one I grabbed at the Border Outpost while I was looking for the evidence you needed. And I remembered you. So I decided to write to you.

The note was a strange one. There's some gibberish on the back. I didn't understand a thing, but maybe you can.

Well, goodbye! I'll get myself a new ship – perhaps we'll meet again in the Astral.

I found a very interesting artifact the other day. Do you remember what I told you about Incarnations? Then check this out: a real Aoidos Spark! It can turn you into an Aoidos - one of those who appeared in our world after the gods died. What do you think?

If you forgot everything I taught you about Incarnations, find me in the Master's Residence, and I will refresh your memory. Or you can also talk to the Experts in the Inexplicable in the faction capital; they are pretty informed, too.

Well, see you.

Klavdia.
Are you ready to accept a special challenge of Dionic Games, Stormbringer? Complete every Dominus' challenge! Prove yourself worthy of the reward!

Hello! On mild spring days everybody wants to change their wardrobe and cheer themselves up with a new outfit or cape. But we at the Holiday Committee decided to cheer you up and give you a few gold coins, which you can use to buy whatever your heart desires!

We all remember the deed of the great martyrs that gave their lives for Sarnaut. Even after their death the fallen Great Mages protect all of us, giving their Patronage to selected heroes. And so that you can honor their great sacrifice, we are giving you some marvelous incense. Burn it to show your respect for your Patron! We will never forget those to whom we owe our very existence!

We have all seen Dreadnoughts, but not all of us have been so lucky as to take a ride on this technical wonder... until now!
The Great Mages have decided to cheer up all the heroes of Sarnaut and have created an exact copy of a real combat Dreadnought. In the next few days anybody who wants to can try out the power of the offensive combat machine, created using ancient June technology. Unfortunately, Dreadnought copies created using magic disappear after a few days, but during that time the land of Sarnaut will tremble with their menacing tread! Enjoy the "Dreadnought War" and good luck!
The game administration apologies for the inconvenience, offering you this compensation. Enjoy the game!

We are glad to inform you that your lost items have been recovered. We return them and wish you good luck in your travels!

Remember that Lost Property Office is always at your service!

The best way to win a beautiful lady's heart is doubtlessly a strong embrace. Mind you, I don't mean hugs and cuddles. I mean manly carrying her in your hands! It involves certain sense of balance and acrobatic skills. Here's a brief manual, describing how to do it. Study it carefully. If you happen to lose it, come by, I'll give you another one.

Good day!

First of all, let me congratulate you on surviving the battle with the Architects.

It is my duty to inform you that we have finally studied the cloning system and received answers to all our questions. You may find it interesting that this technology was initially developed on Ferris without the use of any otherworldly materials. The Object - or the Sculptor - provided the energy source for this miracle of engineering thought. That is why all clones, including pseudo-Herbert and pseudo-Elena, turned into modificants so quickly. Their high intelligence shows that the process of creation a living being from scratch went smoothly, but the deleterious impact of the Sculptor turned out to be deadly.

Most likely, Tep had learned the cloning technology together with the unknown to us principles of matter and energy manipulation after his visit to Ferris.

Sarn, the "Master" of the cultists, took high interest in the researches of Tep and his acolytes. This is how the cloning technology passed from Tep to the cultists' leader - Gorluxor. Comparing their cloning systems proves our theory true.

So, that is it. Thank you for all your efforts in securing our expedition. Murk is looking forward to another adventure like that one and asked me to tell you, I quote: "If you don't call on me next time you fight these hunhurrs, I'll kick the hell out of you!"

Yours respectfully,

Zayan.

P.S.: Herbert and Elena have departed together to an unknown location. I know that most likely they will never be seen anywhere in the League or the Empire territories again. I don't want to disturb their happiness, but if you meet them one day, tell them that they are always welcomed here.

Hello! I'm glad you are following the path of learning. I heard you have completed many great deeds, proving your worth to our kin.

Please take these Water of Death Droplets as a reward for your accomplishments. They will help you to move along the glorious path you have chosen!

Greetings!
You have long been into the mysteries of our world. You have performed a lot of great deeds and grand exploits, proving your class to be the best among all the Sarnaut's people!
I beg you to kindly accept this reward from me - the Water of Death. Be it of help in your further explorations.

Greetings! You have long been questing to understand our world, step by step, mission after mission, all the while showing your allegiance to our class - the best in Sarnaut! Your great deeds will go down in the history of our country!

In recognition of your performance, please accept these Water of Life Droplets. I hope that they will help you in your adventures.

Hello! Please don't throw this letter away! This is not the propaganda of the Trinity Church, nor an advertisement for a new Elven magazine. This is an invitation to a play. The performance should be very exciting, but the results will depend on you. As the saying goes, "all the world's a stage", and you are to be the main actor!
In order to reach the play, please use the mystical stone enclosed within the letter. It will teleport you to the stage. There we can get to know each other better and you can embark on the Path of the Chosen One! I promise that you'll find out some very interesting information when you finish it. I also guarantee that the show will include some amazing adventures! See you soon!
- The Director

Dear friend!
Thank you for choosing one of the graduates from the Aviator School.
We are pleased to announce that we have new courses in our curriculum, related to herbalism and mining. Upon successful completion of these courses, Aviators will be experienced in gathering valuable herbs and mining ore from deposits.
Please find enclosed the detailed manuals helping your Aviator to learn the necessary skills.
Best regards, Head of the Aviator School Rustle Propeller.

Due to changes in the mechanics of Guild Shoulderpad, your current shoulderpad has been removed.

At Heraldry rank 1, the Guild Leader can get the ability to wear a shoulderpad with the guild symbol from the Clerk at the capital. The Leader can also assign the right to wear the shoulderpad to guild members.

You will find compensation for the shoulderpad attached to this letter. Enjoy the game!

Best regards, Allods Online Team.

Greetings, beautiful stranger!
I am pleased to announce that you are invited to a fashion parade at the Hall of Changes. The best stylists, make-up designers and hairdressers will be there to help you become the fairest lady of the Empire! Please accept our gift and be so kind as to visit our Hall of Changes!
Truly yours, Sergey Zverin.

This letter only contains a short message from a "Well-wisher". Seems like it has something to do with obtaining the fifth level of Patronage - a rare and valuable gift. You should find out more about it.
The game administration apologies for any inconvenience arising from the need to change Heraldic Signs, and is offering you compensation. Enjoy the game!
The game administration apologies for any inconvenience arising from the removal of Combat Glory and associated items, and is offering you compensation. Enjoy the game!

We are glad to inform you that your property has been found. We return it and wish you good luck in your travels!

Remember that Lost Property Office is always at your service!

Hi!
Are you bored? Looking for new experience?
The time has come to challenge the past and recover a new part of the Revelation. Show this letter to Gorislav Gipitsky, the innkeeper on Coba Plateau. He will provide you with further directions.
- Director

Your success in conquering the astral shall not go unappreciated!
You have had to invest a great deal of energy, time, and gold to attain these astral stones. Did you think that your efforts have been in vain? Not so! Not a single one of your victories has gone unnoticed! Moreover, each step you've taken in the astral has certain consequences that you will learn of in time... if you don't rest on your laurels, that is!
For now, accept these emblems and protect them as you would your own child. You won't regret it!

Hello! It came to our knowledge that you have moved to a new place. About the time you left, an abandoned Musician's Handbook has been brought to the Lost and Found Department. We believe you were the owner, so we are glad to return it to you! Sincerely, Mail Service of Sarnaut.
Dance and Song Band "Yodel Ayee Oooo"

Learn how to play a new musical instrument and join us in playing and singing! Yodel-ayee-oooo!

Hugs, Sarnaut Dance and Song Band "Yodel Ayee Oooo".

Greetings, Stormbringer!

I’m here to inform you that you are welcome to participate in the Dionic Olympics and compete with other participants. The Domini will be watching the trials, and at the end of the Olympics, the worthy will be rewarded.

Would you like to join? Visit me on the Dionic Archipelago, and I’ll tell you the details.

Hello! It came to our knowledge that you have moved to a new place. About the time you left, a Fidelity unlockable has been brought to the Lost and Found Department. We believe you were the owner, so we are glad to return it to you! Sincerely, Mail Service of Sarnaut.

Hello!
I've just heard about the celebrations organized by the League and Empire governments. I have a gift for you, too.
New adventures are awaiting for you. If you want to try your skills and develop new tactics, these Water of Death Droplets will make it easier. Use them wisely.
Director

Good day, !

On behalf of all Free Traders, I wish you all the luck in your endeavors and offer you our exchange services.

More details are available in the attachment to this letter.

Best regards, Senior Guild Secretary,

Aelita de Grandeur.

Hi!
I think you've already guessed that your world isn't the only one in this universe? But now you've witnessed it with your own eyes!
The merging of worlds is an extremely rare event that can help you make both new friends and new enemies...
But anyway, you'll figure all that out without me. Here's a gift for you to help you adapt to the altered world. I hope you'll find it to your liking.
Director

Please be aware that guilds of gatherers and crafters have been merged! Crafters can now collect materials for their profession themselves, and gatherers are able to create useful items from their findings. If you mastered both of the related crafting and gathering professions before the merger, you are eligible to pick up a new profession for free.

In view of disabling Astral Confrontation and replacing it with Dominion, all bets placed for the last Astral Confrontation are returned to the guild representatives who participated in the auction. Enjoy the game!

Hello again!
We haven't talked in a while. I hope you will like the new amusement I have arranged. What's in it for me? I want to pick out all worthy fighters of Sarnaut to prepare them for a very important mission.
But everything in its right time. Now, you should travel to Gipat and talk to the Spirit of Peace. Such an irony - the matter you are going to discuss will be the upcoming war. Who knows what else must be done to save the world...
Longing to see you again,
Director

Dark days have come for Umoir, friend... First the Leper came, now the undead are rioting. We don't have much resources to keep protecting our land... We won't last long.

The cause of our misfortune is hidden deep in the Ancient Mound. The undeat and the Leper are coming out from there. There's an ancient Demon deep down there, that's what the wise men say. As long as we're alive, we have to fight it. I'm only afraid we won't stand for too long, not without help, anyway.

I'm begging you to help us.

Friend! You look like you're bored! The League and the Empire stopped fighting, Nihaz is locked up in his Citadel, the guilds have long figured out who is the coolest here... Overall, it's decay and hopelessness all around.  But sometimes you feel like hitting your neighbor with a heavy hammer between the eyes, right?

I think I how to make your day better. Remember the Melting Isle? We had a lot of fun there. I think we can bring back those good old days, and a new outfit wouldn't hurt either.

Anyway, why don't we get down to business. Go to Gipat, to the June ruins. I will tell you the latest news there.

Are you tired of bloody skirmishes? Astral flights seem boring? Can't find anything to do?

Another summer has come to Sarnaut, herohero!

Wherever you are: on hot Suslanger, in mysterious Eden, on frosty Isa or on foggy Jigran, remember - a tropical resort is waiting for you!

This year, both new and old activities are ready to entertain you! Warm waves have tossed pebbles of the most bizarre shades on our shores, and prizes now include new costumes and other valuables. Perhaps you want to try your hand at the Athletic Competition with other players? Or try your luck in betting on a randomly selected crab? Solve the riddles of Gugu the Serene?

My dear friend, I insist - because you absolutely must see our spectacular star showers!

We have put things in order after the Urun attack, and now we can offer you all sorts of tasks! Broddie wants to protect Skalgard, the Thread Keepers see different predictions, and my brothers and I want to join the Winter Watch! And everyone needs your help, so come back soon!

And don't think we'll just make you run around for nothing. You will be rewarded, of course! The Smile and Nutlet Families are working on that, in fact! You'll see what we have, and there is a little advance attached to the letter for you!

I believe you've been waiting for word from me for some time, ...

The time has come. The barricades at the exits from the city have been removed - Hirkalla's guards have driven off most of the distorted creatures.

It means we can move on - if you remember, we still need to find five more "odd people out" whose fates have been stolen.

Please, hurry – the sooner we continue our search, the greater our chances of success.
